youtube.baslik: Which surface in the audiology booth is most often forgotten? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In audiology, the most common route of infection is contact; the response button and chair arms are high-touch surfaces that are often forgotten. Listing the surfaces to wipe after every patient, namely the earphones, vibrator, probe, response button and chair arms, on a short checklist hung on the booth wall makes the work easier; on a busy day, the step most often forgotten is the response button.
